description: EU & global ESG controversy intel for compliance and trading agents. Detects company ESG controversies (environmental, social, governance) from worldwide news in real time, then enriches each with GLEIF entity resolution (LEI + country of domicile) and EU sanctions-list screening. Pillar-classified, severity-graded, source-linked. Each controversy's company must be named in the story's own web address, not only among its entities. Pass region='EU' for companies domiciled in the 27 EU member states. News-derived breadth (complements the authoritative SEC-filing ESG product hsh-esg-events). Pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

pillar.description: Filter by pillar: E, S, or G.

region.description: Pass 'EU' to filter to EU-domiciled companies.

name: hsh-esg-news
